summary: 21Shares XRP ETF filed an 8-K reporting the termination of a material definitive agreement: its Pricing Benchmark Licensing Agreement with CF Benchmarks Ltd., effective August 31, 2026, in connection with a transition to FTSE International Limited as a new benchmark provider. The termination reflects a routine vendor change and does not involve acquisition, divestiture, or any corporate restructuring event. No deal terms, premium, or shareholder action applies. This is a service provider switch with no special-situation implications.
